_readme: Folder-based assignment map, used with --map-file. Copy to your maps_dir (see regression_cycle.maps_dir in qa-config.json) and fill in your own people and modules. Never commit a filled-in copy - it holds real Jira account ids.
_note_level: Which segment of the test's Test Repository folder path is the module. Path /Product/System Test/Customer Screen/... with level 3 gives module 'Customer Screen'. Omit to default to 3.
_note_people: accountId -> display name. Names are for the report only; the accountId is what gets written. Find an accountId with the Atlassian MCP lookupJiraAccountId, or from the user's Jira profile URL.
_note_modules: Module name -> the accountId that owns it. Every module the Test Set contains must appear here or its tests come back UNMAPPED. Keep one person in adjacent areas rather than balancing counts.
_note_default: Optional. accountId that takes every test not matched by 'modules'. A single-owner execution (e.g. a smoke run) is just an empty 'modules' plus a 'default'.
